content.content:
Okan-Zish: "Dead? Truly dead? Then my raft goes back on the water and I can breathe again, and I must tell you everything now, quickly, before I think better of it. It was our doing. Wuleen-Taza, who rafts with me, dumped fish offal from our bait bucket off the end of the walk, night after night, so that traders would think a beast lived there and keep away from Sells-Dear's boat. And it drew in a real one, a true crocodile, the one you killed. The bucket was left in the shallows off the end of the walk; none of us dared go down for it. Sells-Dear, the boat captain, must not see it. I beg you to say nothing, because she would take the whole river trade from us if she heard. I will say it plainly, so that you choose with open eyes. Wuleen-Taza will pay you to keep quiet, and you will find her by the bridge near this tower. Sells-Dear will pay to see the bucket, and she stands north of the landing, by a house door on the west side of Helstrom's street. Fetch it for her and the river trade is hers and the crew is finished. Leave it, and we keep our rafts. I am asking you to leave it."
